name: PFWL World Championship
epitaph: Held by Petty Officer Pain at the founding-era PPV; "Badd Boy" Derrick Stardom challenges by RoughHouse 96.

name: PFWL Pro Championship
epitaph: Held by Volcano across the recorded cards; Kinkos earns a title shot by defeating Johnny Dingo.

name: PFWL Jr Championship
epitaph: Won by "Dirty" Dan Fuller over Ted Rayden at the founding-era PPV; defends successfully at RoughHouse 96.

name: PFWL North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Titan Team named first champions at the founding-era PPV.

name: PFWL World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by "P&P" per the RSPWF awards-ballot sig-block bycatch record (dated 10-27-96 through 03-30-97).
